title: Mode changes
description: Every job a mode changes in one brand of a scheme, by group, with what each mode points it at. Drawn by the ModeChanges composite on Foundations › Theming.

modes.description: The modes, in column order, such as light and dark.

groups.description: Each group of jobs, such as surface or text.

job.description: The token, without its group, such as canvas or primary.

cells.description: What each mode points the job at, in the order of modes.

primitive.description: The primitive a color ends at, without color.

via.description: The semantic it goes through, without color., when it does.

value.description: The value, for a job that is not a color.
